narrative: SMS warning about an unauthorized loan debit.

message.body: URGENT: Auto-debit of ₹49,999 for EMI Loan #9941 is scheduled in 15 mins. If you did NOT authorize this, cancel immediately at http://apex-debit-cancel.com

evidence.label: Apex Bank Customer Service
evidence.value: Customer care confirms no loan #9941 exists on your account.

consequence_text.safe: You called your bank customer service out-of-band and confirmed no loan debit existed.
consequence_text.unsafe: Clicking panic-inducing cancellation links delivers your banking login to attackers.

teaching_point: Fake cancellation warnings exploit panic to bypass independent verification.
